product.title: Girona and Costa Brava Private Tour with Pick-up from Barcelona

description.text: Escape the crowds of Barcelona and explore another Catalonian city, as well as some of the most scenic coastal areas in a single day. This private tour takes you to see the most important sights in Girona, including the cathedral's exterior and the Jewish Quarter (El Call), and along the Costa Brava to enjoy the stunning coastal views. Stops include Girona Cathedral, Jewish Quarter, Calella de Palafrugell, Far de Sant Sebastià. Coach logistics are handled so visitors can focus on Girona streets and Costa Brava villages named on the itinerary. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
